rss: Half the harvest, twice the bills: how drought hit farms
title: Farms Face Tough Year with Drought
story: Farmers have a tricky time when there's a drought. They can't grow as many crops and have to pay more to keep things running.
storyBig: Farmers are experiencing reduced harvests due to drought conditions, which has led to increased operational costs and reduced crop yields. This poses a significant challenge to maintaining profitability.
think: What can farms do to prepare for dry weather?
bull: Farms might invest in new ways to save water.
bear: Less rain means fewer crops and higher costs.

rss: Rainmakers: The drones used to seed clouds
title: Drones Help Make Rainy Days
story: Using drones to make it rain is becoming popular. These drones spray special stuff into clouds to help them make rain.
storyBig: Drones are increasingly being utilized for cloud seeding, a process where chemicals are dispersed into clouds to encourage rainfall. This innovative approach is gaining traction as a potential solution to water shortages.
think: How could making rain with drones help farmers?
bull: Drones might help bring rain when it's needed most.
bear: Not all clouds can be turned into rainmakers.
